balls.text: Deccan Charges have been shot out for 110. It was tapped to right of point and the throw, from Hafeez, was slightly wide but Saha, the 'keeper, lunged to his right, collected the ball, turned quickly to whip off the bails. Very smart work from him and Knight Riders need 111 to win.
After a lovely classy shot, he falls to a swipe across the line. He tried to slog a turning delivery over midwicket. Instead, it lobbed up to covers.
Fabulous shot from Bangar. He waltzed down the track, reached the pitch of a flighted delivery and drove it inside-out through covers.
on the middle and leg, worked through midwicket. Bangar wants the strike

Vaas is unable to counter the pitch. Again, the ball stopped on the batsman and Vaas tried to check his on drive. Too late. The ball stopped and jumped and went off the leading edge to a delighted Ganguly at covers.
yorker just outside off, dug out to point for a single

Symonds falls after a very fine 32. It was a length delivery well outside off and Symonds wanted to carve it over the off side but it stopped on him and all he could do was present a simple catch to mid-off
gets the single this time with a nudge through backward point
beaten by the slower one. Bangar wanted to take a single to rotate the strike and was walking into a delivery outside off stump
starts off with a full toss, hit to long-off
full and quick, Bangar tries to heave this one but can't connect properly
Bangar goes down town. Murder! Clean hit and it flew over wide long-on.
No 2 comes up. Symonds just leans forward and swings a full delivery over the cow corner. The Deccan Chargers have pressed the accelerator
Symonds has had enough. It was a short delivery that turned in, Symonds rocked back to pull it high over deep midwicket boundary
spins too much and goes down leg side
big turn and Symonds is beaten. It runs off the pad to the leg side
short and outside off, cut hard to sweeper cover
short and outside off stump, cut to right of deep backward point
slower one, full and well outside off stump and Ishant is unhappy with the call. It was pretty fair call, though.
it broke away off a length, spun away is the word actually, and bounced once before it reached the 'keeper
again that puff of dust, the ball stops on the batsman and Symonds very skil fully waits for the ball, adjusts his hands and taps it to backward point. Very well played Sir!
fuller, outside off and square driven past point
full in length, outside off stump, left alone
spins sharply, down the leg side and Symonds glances it fine, past the diving short fine-leg fielder
stretches across and whips effectively with the turn to deep midwicket
flighted full, driven to long-on
caught at long-off. Full and outside off, Arjun went for a lofted drive, this time from the confines of the crease, and holes out at the deep.
a touch short, outside off, dabbed to point
Third six of the game. Arjun, the son of Shivlal, is the man who  does it. He charged down the track, reached the pitch of a flighted delivery and swung it over long-on
a touch short and Arjun punches it to deep point
leans forward to dab one through the leg side for a single.
this one spins and again, the same response from Symonds
a straighter one this time, Symonds carefully nudges it back down the track.
turns in, on the pad, and they pick up a leg bye
fuller and driven back to the bowler
turns in, beats the hurried jab and strikes the pad. Going down leg, though
leans forward to driven to long-on
loopy delivery outside off and Arjun stretches across to defend
turns in sharply, Symonds arrests his front-foot movement and turns it behind square leg
flighted full and driven to long-on for a single
straighter one, on the off stump, Symonds defends to the leg side
flighted one outside off stump, driven to mid-off for a single
Change of pace and length does the trick. The crowd roar their delight. It was quicker, it was full and Styris yorked himself, trying to tap it to the on side. Cleaned up.
on the middle and leg, tucked behind square leg
stretches across to defend, misses and is hit on the pad outside off stump
turns in from outside off and Symonds stabs it to the off side
turning outside off stump, squeezed off the outside edge, down to third man boundary
worked to midwicket region
armer, on the middle and leg, Symonds went back and is hit on the pad. A appeal goes up and the umpire felt it would have missed leg. The hawk eye says it would have clipped leg
OMG! what a ripper. Unplayable. It drifted in, landed on middle and leg, gripped, turned, bounced and spun past the off stump,  past the poke.
tries a paddle sweep but doesn't connect well
again on the middle and leg line, turned to midwicket.
spins towards the pad, tucked behind square. He has to start from well outside off to be effective
fuller, outside off, spins in, Symonds went for a rather ambitious off drive against the turn but just gets an inside edge
spins in to evade the waft and runs off the pad to short fine-leg
leans forward to turn a flighted delivery to square leg
pushed to extra cover for a single
leans forward to defend

Rohit is gone. Flighted delivery, full and on the middle and leg, it dipped rapidly before Rohit could get forward to defend and ran off the inside-edge onto the pad and popped up to the unmanned  short leg position and Saha, the 'keeper, rushes across to take a lunging catch
beaten by big turn. He leaned forward to defend but the ball jumped, spun and teased the outside edge
holed out to long leg. It was a short delivery and Gilchrist swiveled to pull it but ended up top-edging it to the fielder. Chargers are running out of battery.
stretches across to dab a turning delivery to covers
Big turn. Is it Hafeez or Muralitharan?! It landed way outside off and spun past Symonds and down the leg side
floated outside off, full, defended to the off side
gets a inside-edge as the ball kicks up but will pick a single as the ball rolled towards square leg
jumps out to have a big swing but ends up yorking himself. He charged out too far
around off stump, pushed to point.
from round the stumps, on the middle line, pushed back to the bowler
leans forward to defend to the off side
Now then, that's a ripper. It spun sharply from the middle stump, jumped up and left a bemused Symonds. Ponting rushes across from first slip  to have a chat with Murali Kartik
flighted one, full and outside off, Symonds opened the bat-face and guided it past the slip. Very skilful stroke. He was unsure initially, didn't read the flight properly but adjusted to push it away
spins towards the pads again, and Gilchrist works it behind square leg for a single
turns in towards the pad, worked to the leg side
on the middle and leg, turning in, placed towards midwicket for a single
drifts on the legs, turned to short fine-leg fielder.
fuller and straight, defended back down the track
And it's not over yet. Full, wide, outside off and Gilchrist says thank you and slams it to the deep backward point boundary
It takes special talent on this pitch to go for two sixes in one over. Agarkar does it. It was again outside leg stump and Gilly again flicks it over long leg
The top soil is coming off already. It landed outside leg, on a length and just spun across! Gilly was stunned and just had a poke and a miss.
Swung over long leg. Agarar offers a loose delivery - full and outside leg and Gilly just helps it up and over.
cut and a miss. Flashes at a short-of-length delivery which doesn't climb much
fuller, cuts in from just outside off stump, Symonds is late in getting forward but manages to jab it away to the leg side
on a length, on the middle stump line, defended on the back foot.

The pitch takes out VVS. It was a short delivery and as any batsman would do, VVS went for the pull but it stopped on him, VVS couldn't get out of the shot and just managed to flat bat it a dolly to mid-off.
stops on VVS and he wrists it down to midwicket. VVS walks down to have a very close look at the spot. Big puff of dust flew up that time.
Gilly swings at a length delivery and it runs away to the right of mid-on
cuts in, evades the waft and hits him high on the front pad.
Nasty lifter and VVS is in pain. VVS leaned forward to defend a length delivery but was shocked as it kicked up brutally to crash into the left glove.
In the zone outside off stump, left alone
This one keeps low. VVS lets the delivery go past him outside off stump
caught at gully. The previous one stopped on the batsman, this one kicked up a touch even as it came in from outside off to cramp up Venu and he ended up guiding it straight to the fielder.
the janus-faced pitch is acting up. This one stops on the batsman and Venu is early into his cut and can't connect. Again that puff of dust.
comes in from the off stump line, Venu pats it gently to the off side and off they rush across for a quick single
slashed over slip. He threw his bat at a short-of-length delivery outside off and got a thick and profitable edge.
on a length, angled across, dabbed to wide third man
keeps low and goes under the bat, outside off

another one jumps up from a length and Gilly can't connect well with his pull shot.  Well... its an interesting track and some might say, it makes for interesting viewing. The white ball is not flying everywhere for a change
on the leg and middle, tucked behind square leg for a single
fuller, straighter and driven to covers
Again down the leg side, Gilly has a swing and a miss.
leans forward to push a full delivery to mid-on
And this one keeps low. Hmm... not a ideal track, this. This one was down the leg side and Gilly survives. Had it been straight, he could have been in trouble
ooh another lifter! The pitch is certainly doing things. It kicked up alarmingly, Venu took out the bottom-hand and stabbed at it, the ball flew off the glove and went to the off side
beaten outside off. It lifted from short of length and straightened outside off, Venu jabbed at it and was beaten. Puff of dust came up as the ball landed  and Venu has a close look at the spot
full and on the middle and off, pushed to extra cover for a single
length delivery, jumps, slips down the leg, off the hips and Saha flies to his left to make a impressive take. He appeals for a catch and suggests later, that it went of the gloves.
Overthrows! It was patted to right of point and what should have been just a single has turned into five runs. Wild throw at the non-striker's ends with no one backing up.
probing delivery outside off and Venu shoulders arms.
swing and a miss. Full in length, again a hint of away movement, a touch wide and Venu failed to reach it with a cut
Caught at long-on but then it's a free hit. Gilly was nearly run out, though. Venu had lofted a length delivery straight up and Gilly came back for the second.
curving delivery outside off stump, Venu thinks about offering a shot before withdrawing his bat. And folks, the next one is going to be a free hit. Gilly charges across to have a word with Venu
quiet start: Gilchrist stays back to flick a length delivery on the middle and leg past square leg for a single

Game over! David Hussey has done it. Flighted one, on the stumps and Hussey murdered it straight over the bowler's head and it kept flying into the horizon. The Eden Gardens erupts. The Knight Riders are on a roll here in this tournament. What a dramatic nail-biting game we have had this evening. Easily, the best of the tournament so far. And we are just into the fourth game of the IPL. Hopefully, more such drama awaits us.

loopy flighted one on the middle and leg, Hussey tries to work it to the leg side, gets a leading edge to covers. he sets off for a run, Symonds rushes to his left, swoops and flicks it to Gilly. Had it been a direct hit, Hussey would have got out. It was refered upstairs and the crowd shout a cry of relief as NOT OUT comes on the board.
connects with his sweep this time and gets a single. Five from eight balls. What fun!
on the middle and leg, full, he opts for a sweep and under edges it to his pad
flighted delivery on the middle and leg, he tries to work it to the on side, misses as the ball turns but they take a leg bye.
leans forward, dabs a full delivery to the leg side and a quick single is taken

And a glance to fine leg now. Surely, now, the Knight Riders can't lose this. It was on the middle and leg, Hussey shuffled across and glided it fine. Very fine. The crowd are up on their feet and the decibels level is crazy

Whoa! A stunning hit from David Hussey. Is it the game? Full, straight, the left leg was taken out of the line and a fierce swing saw the white ball fly over long-on. What a crucial hit that. The younger brother of Mike Hussey, the hero last night, is turning it on here. The family back home must be loving it.
almost bowled by the slower one! Hussey charged out and had a mighty heave, missed and it just went over the bails

oh more drama. He went for a paddle sweep, top edged a full toss outside off on to his body and the ball rolled down the track. Styris rushed across, so did the batsman and they collide! Styris says he was within his rights to stay on the wicket and the batsman had to run around him. Phew!
slower one, just outside off and he missed an intended whip and again they rush across for a quick run.
cuts in off a length, from outside off stump, gets a inside-edge to a hurried jab to the leg side. Styris appealed .
flighted outside off, he gets forward and pushes to the offside
turned to backward point
leans forward to tap a full delivery to midwicket. Too full again.

The reverse sweep goes awry. He went for a fierce reverse slap but top edged it over covers and Symonds took it running back. Hafeez was playing an counter-attacking game and thought he could get away with the reverse sweep but ...
turns away from Hussey who steers to cover point for a quick single this time. Rohit rushed in but they got across in time
goes back to push a delivery on the middle to cover point
What a cheeky paddle from Hafeez. He went down on his knee and lapped a full toss past short fine leg. RP is bowling the wrong length here.
fuller, not the right length on this track, better to hit the deck on a length and allow the pitch to do the trick- driven to covers
This one landed on a length outside off and just broke away! Hafeez was looking for a big hit and was beaten comprehensively. RP has a big smile.Game on a knife's' edge here.
angles in towards middle, Hussey stays beside the line, opens the bat-face and guides to cover point for a quick single.
full and outside off stump, slashed off the outer edge to third man
rushes through the channel outside off, Hafeez tries to run it down to third man but misses
on the middle and leg, nudged to the on side

on the pads, again dabbed to the leg side for a quick single. Gilchrist rushed after it, picked, turned and fired a throw at non-striker's end. Had it been accurate, the batsman would have been a goner
on the pads, tucked to square leg
full and outside leg, turned to midwicket
drifts in, lands on middle and spins sharply past the outside edge. Hafeez was trying to tap it past the slip fielder
goes right back to guide to backward point

What a cracker from Mohammad Hafeez. Symonds sent across another seam-up length delivery on the off stump and Hafeez, rather nonchalantly -as if anyone could do that on this track - rocked back to knife it on the up, through the line and over long-on. Stunning hit
outside off and cut to wide third man
on a length, straightens around off, edged to third man
lands on a length, outside off, acts normally and is guided to backward point
almost edged to Gilly. It shot up from a length, Haffeez poked and got a thin edge which didn't carry
full and driven to long-on
The left-arm spinner takes out Ganguly. It doesn't happen often. It was a loopy flighted delivery on the stumps, Ganguly went for a almighty heave across the line and missed it completely

OMG! what a ripper! Not even Bradman can play that. It drifted in, landed well outside leg, gripped, spun sharply with bounce and past the outside edge. Forget Bradman, George Headley, supposedly a better player on wet wickets, could have been beaten.
lands outside leg, turns but not enough.
charges out but is done in by the flight and then by the turn and it runs away to the square leg region
fuller and driven hard but straight to VVS at covers
flighted delivery, turns in, beats the defensive shot, and pops up off the pad to Gilly who appeals.
starts off with a wide down the leg side.
outside off stump, cut to third man
another lifter, Ganguly pulls out of an intended pull shot and a no ball is called. For the height. Looked harsh.
length delivery on the off stump, punched past the lunging Symonds for a single
on a length, on the off stump, cut to third man. 50 from 50 .
Gilly has to stand back if this continues. It was just outside leg and again it jumped over Gilly' reach. Ganguly had shuffled to the off side and tried to paddle it over
Wild swing and a miss. Wide called.It was slanted across Ganguly who missed a pull.
turned to left of midwicket
How do you play that? What a awkward lifter. It shot up from just short of length, climbed head-high and kept rising! The batsman pulled out of the shot and Gilly couldn't reach it
Symonds is bowling mediumpace. It straightens from a length, on the off stump, gets a outside edge and runs to point

just short of the diving mid-on fielder and bursts through the fingers. It was full, just outside off and Ganguly drove it hard. It was in the air but dropped short of the fielder who dived forward and ended up giving four runs
another off cutter, Hussey manages to work it behind square leg
ah! this one cuts in and it bounces awkwardly to beat the defensive prod and hits him on the body.
Wow! a stunning hit. He backed away, to the leg side and killed a full delivery over extra cover boundary.
length delivery on the off stump line, pushed to cover point
on the stumps. pushed down the track
fuller and just outside the off stump, Ganguly presses his front leg across and is hit on the pad
fuller and outside off, left alone
beaten by another off cutter that just screamed up off a length. Ganguly wanted to turn it to the leg side but the ball kept climbing!
slower one, off cutter and it evades the defensive waft and runs off the glove to the off side
ooh.. that one cut away after landing outside off stump. Wide given. Styris is not happy but it did look a fair call. Especially on this track.
tries to late cut a delivery angled across him but misses.
stops on Ganguly who adjusts to swat it away through wide midwicket.
fuller, right up there, turned to midwicket
shorter in length, worked to midwicket. Just a wide so far in this over.
lands on the length around off, moves towards middle and pushed down the track
wide down the leg side and Gilchrist, standing up to the stumps, manages to make a half-stop
short of length, on the off and middle, punched to Rohit at backward point
again that shuffle, this ball straightens and is defended to the off side
full and on the stumps, shuffles across and pushes it down the track
full again, driven to extra cover. Tight over comes to an end. This match is getting very interesting.
fuller and defended to covers.
stops a touch but Ganguly adjusts to push it to point
cutting across Ganguly who reaches out to tap it to right of  point where Rohit Sharma makes a diving stop
off cutter on the middle and Hussey manages to clip it to fine leg
leans forward to drive a full delivery to mid-off
length delivery on the middle and off line, David goes back, wrists it to midwicket
fullish, outside off and Ganguly drives pleasingly to deep cover.
on the stumps, turned to the point region
wide down the leg side. The release went awry. He wanted to bowl a off cutter but didn't release it properly
Super stop from Symonds. It was pushed to his left at covers but he dived full stretch to make the stop
on a length, around off stump, pushed to the off side
on a length, on the middle and off, defended to the off side
on a length, around the off stump, nothing alarming this time and Ganguly pushes it carefully into covers for a single
slower and he pings the long-on with a drive
cuts in again and defended to the on side. A rather hesitant prod there
cuts in from the middle and off, he walked right across, exposing the leg stump and the ball missed the leg stump, not by much, though
offcutter and it spun in sharply and stabbed to the on side
full, slow through the air, it stops a touch and Ganguly plays an uppish drive to deep cover
another one that jumped up, this one goes off the left glove as he tries to fend it away

another nasty one and Ganguly throws his bat after getting hit on the chest. It leaped up from a length, Ganguly leaned forward to defend the ball and was surprised by  the extra bounce. He doubled up in pain, threw his bat to the ground and walked towards square leg. In the stands, Usha Uthup, the popular Indian singer, can't believe what she saw. There is an agonized look on her face as she watched her favourite Dada get hit.
even fuller and Hussey drives to left of mid-off for a single
full and on the middle stump line, gets a inside-edge on to the pad as he tries to nudge it to the off side

Three down and the game hangs in a balance. Vaas takes out the pace off the ball, by rolling his fingers around the seam and Saha, who was looking good, tried to check his off drive. Too late Sir. Caught at mid-off.
stretches across to guide a full delivery to point
fuller but slipping on to the legs, turned to long leg for a single
nasty lifter. It rose alarmingly from a length and Saha does well to jab it down off his glove.
Outside off stump, keeps a touch low, Ganguly has  a waft, gets a thick outside edge and it rolls along the ground to left of the lone slip fielder in Laxman who lunges to make a half-stop
on the middle and leg, clipped to long leg
beaten outside off. It was angled across him and Saha had a near-fatal poke. Laxman runs across to have a chat with RP
leans forward to drive to mid-off
this one jumps even as it comes in and Saha takes out the bottom-hand off the handle in a hurry and jabs it behind square
kicks up from a length, stabbed to the off side

loud shout for lbw but  Bowden turns it down. And he gives it a leg bye. Hmm... I thought and Ganguly hinted that there was an inside edge. If it didn't hit the bat, it looked pretty straight. It was full and around the off stump and shaping in. Perhaps, Bowden reckoned he was struck outside off. But the point was impact in line
around the off stump, steered to backward point. Ganguly played a fab knock on a similar track in Kanpur. Can he do it here again for the Knight Riders?

trapped lbw. Ponting is unhappy. The hawk eye says it would gone just over. Not too much. It landed on middle and leg line and straightened. Ponting was on the lunge and was beaten by the straightening. I think he thought it had pitched outside leg, but it hadn't.
Shot boss! It was short of length, just outside off, bounced a bit but Saha adjusted well to get on top of the bounce  and cut superbly past point
again drifting down the leg side, no wood on leather but it runs off the pad to fine-leg boundary
fullish, on middle and leg, wristed to deep square-leg region
lands on a length, just outside off and came in, defended to the off side

McCullum falls to the vagaries of the wicket. He was trying to clip the length delivery around middle and  leg line to the leg side but it stopped on him and jumped to get the leading edge and lobbed to point
hurls one full from round the stumps, McCullum walks across outside off, tries to whip it away, misses and is hit on the pad.
full, on the middle and off, the ball stops on Saha who defends to the off side. Since he was not into a drive he adjusted and just tapped it away
stretches across to steer a delivery angled across him to point
straightens from a length, on the middle and punched to extra cover
leans forward to defend a full delivery
McCullum is still in Bangalore. He stands a foot outside the crease and clips a length delivery on the middle to deep backward square leg
